author: New China TV
description:
🤖 AI is smart and never even needs a break! So, will humans get to clock off early or get laid off early? 😅 What does the future hold for media?
Let's hear what media professionals at the World Media Summit have to say! 🎤🌍
title: AI is getting smarter. What's next for human journalists?

author: New China TV
description: From humanoid robots and smart cleaning machines to advanced medical technology and next-generation air purifiers, the 9th China International Import Expo (CIIE) is bringing the world's latest innovations under one roof. Join Xinhua Live as we explore exciting global debuts, meet industry businessmen, and discover why China's dynamic market continues to attract businesses from around the world. Let's take a peek at the technologies shaping the future! (recorded)
title: LIVE: Robots, smart tech & global innovations! Exploring CIIE 2026

author: New China TV
description: The World Media Summit, running from Nov. 5 to 9, has brought together representatives from 112 countries and regions to Beijing to forge consensus and joint action amid the intelligent age. Our Xinhua correspondent has followed the international delegation through their tech tours and forum exchanges. Check out the video for insights!
title: World Media Summit guests gather in Beijing for consensus, action in intelligent age

author: New China TV
description: Newsrooms are adopting AI faster than ever -- for writing, editing and even presenting the news. At the 7th World Media Summit in Beijing, we asked media leaders where the line should be drawn. Here's what they said.
title: Global media leaders weigh AI, future of journalism at World Media Summit

author: New China TV
description:
On May 1, China removed tariffs on imports from 53 African countries with diplomatic ties. Six months later, African products are taking the spotlight at the ninth China International Import Expo (CIIE) in Shanghai. We walk the Africa aisle booth by booth to see what's on offer — and how zero tariffs could open new doors for African exporters in China.（recorded)
#CIIE2026 #Africa #ZeroTariff #ChinaAfrica
title: A walk through Africa's aisle at CIIE 2026

author: New China TV
description: New Zealand's ruling National-led coalition has secured a parliamentary majority in the general election, preliminary results showed on Saturday night, putting Prime Minister Christopher Luxon on course to retain power for a second term. #NewZealand #GeneralElection
title: New Zealand's National-led coalition wins re-election: preliminary results

title: Seeing is believing: World Media Summit guests experience China's EV prowess in Beijing

description:

description:
Delegates attending the World Media Summit got a firsthand look at China's latest robotics technologies during a visit to the Beijing World of Robots.

What role do you think robots will play in our future? 
#WorldMediaSummit #Robotics #AI #ChinaTech #Innovation #FutureTech

description:

What brought them here, and what makes them want to return? Join our reporter Yuqi on the expo floor to find out. #CIIE2026

China's zero-tariff treatment is opening new trade doors for 53 African countries that have diplomatic relations with China.

#CIIE #Shanghai #ZeroTariffPolicy #ChinaAfrica #Trade
